ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a bending road represented by black lines, starting point 1 is beside the vertical road segment on the right, and the arrow indicates that Gerda initially walks upward; endpoint 2 is below the vertical road segment slightly left of the interior. Around the road there are multiple boxed letters, including K on the right, A at the top, N on the left, O in the left-middle, O and R in the interior, A at the lower right, and G at the bottom. Then reason: Follow the continuous road from starting point 1 according to the arrow to endpoint 2, and on each segment judge the right-hand side according to the current direction of travel. When starting upward, the right-hand side is on the right side of the figure, so first record K; continue turning and proceeding along the road, and next encounter N on the right-hand side; after that, A and O appear in sequence on the right-hand side. The other letters are not on the right-hand side for the corresponding direction of travel, so they are not recorded. The recording order is K, N, A, O.

raw_record.question_text: Gerda walks along the road and writes down the letters she can see on her right hand side. Which word is formed while Gerda walks from point 1 to point 2?

method.method_draft: Trace the continuous road in the diagram starting at the circled point 1, using the arrow to fix Gerda’s initial walking direction, and follow the road until the circled point 2. At each straight section or turn, determine Gerda’s right-hand side relative to her current direction of travel, then record only the boxed letters that lie on that side in the order encountered. The letters visible on the right side along the route are K first near the starting vertical segment, then N on the next relevant side of the road, then A, then O, forming KNAO.
